QuestInfo.name: A Young Island
QuestInfo.0: Mercedes has finally come home! Explain to her what happened on Maple Island and see if she can help.
QuestInfo.1: Mercedes has finally come home! Explain to her what happened on Maple Island and see if she can help.
QuestInfo.2: You explain to Mercedes all that transpired on Maple Island. \r\nShe explains that the island didn't exist when the Seal Stones were created, which means there's no Seal Stone for Maple Island...

0.0: Now tell me, #h0#, why have you sought me out? \r\n#L0##b(You fill her in on everything that happened on Maple Island and ask about Seal Stones.#l\n#k
0.1: Maple Island is in ruins? That's awful. Unfortunately... \r\n#L0##bUnfortunately what?#l\n#k
0.2: While it's true that we created the Seal Stones to restore the continents to how they were after the Black Mage sacked them, the problem is... #bMaple Island didn't exist back then.#k\r\n#L0##bWhich means... You guys never created a Seal Stone for Maple Island.#l\n#k
0.3: You are correct. I'm sorry to be the bearer of such bad news. \r\n#L0##bSo we can't save Maple Island...#l\n#k
0.4: I understand this is a shock. But remember, through hard work and persistence, you can still make a difference. You can rebuild your island, one brick at a time.

yes.0: Your undying courage reminds me of the other Heroes.

no.0: Come speak to me when you are done sulking.

1.0: May your faith bolster you in the hard days to come.
1.1: On a lighter note, I think Moonie really likes your song. Would you be willing to give the score to him as a gift?

yes.0: Thank you. May Sylvidia's protection be with you.
